mapper.insert: INSERT INTO send_log (group_id, target_user_id, message_type, message_id, content, success, error_msg, created_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{targetUserId}, #{messageType}, #{messageId}, #{content}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM send_log WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail_count, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM send_log

SELECT group_id as groupId, SUM(CASE WHEN success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail_count, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM send_log WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT sl.group_id as groupId, tg.group_name as groupName, SUM(CASE WHEN sl.success = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sl.success = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as fail_count, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM send_log sl LEFT JOIN tg_group tg ON sl.group_id = tg.group_id GROUP BY sl.group_id, tg.group_name ORDER BY total_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM send_log WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND message_type = 'ad' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM send_log WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND message_type = 'ad' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
